limitations.note: The agent registered the counter decode but also gated it with `valid_a`, so `valid_b` stays low during a stall at count five when the correct registered decode would assert it.
Tying `ready_a` high changed its reset value and allowed input capture on the first edge after reset, whereas the original and correct designs use that edge to raise `ready_a`.

The scoreboard exercised gaps before the sixth bit but expected valid only on the sixth accepted bit and ready high even during reset, so it confirmed the rewrite's assumptions rather than detecting either timing discrepancy.
